mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers a labor market tightening cycle, raising expectations of inflation and growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not cross the 4.0% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and growth in economic demand (GDPC1) creates a dual signal of accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, amplifying equity valuation growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and GDPC1 growth > 2% over last quarter
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns do not outperform baseline in co-occurring periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in labor market activity (PAYEMS rising) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) signals a loose labor market, fostering growth expectations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over last month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 60-day returns do not outperform baseline in triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in housing demand (HOUST exceeding 1800 units) triggers a surge in economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite HOUST crossing the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment claims (UNRATE) and job growth (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, raising inflation expectations and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% over last month
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 60-day returns do not outperform baseline in co-occurring periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain resilience, prompting optimism about earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite sustained INDPRO growth.
